page: Google Cloud Platform n4-highmem-64 is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel processor with 64 dedicated vCPUs, consisting of 32 physical cores and 2 threads per core. It features 512 GB of RAM, providing a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. The CPU cache configuration includes 48 KB L1d, 2 MB L2, and 260 MB L3 cache. This server does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, relying entirely on network-attached storage for persistent data.

Benchmark results show strong memory performance, with uncached read bandwidth at 276.11 GB/sec and write bandwidth at 121.94 GB/sec. Multi-core processing is also strong, as demonstrated by a Geekbench multi-core score of 17904.0 and a Passmark CPU score of 62986.78. The server achieves top-tier performance in static web serving throughput at 88.31 GB/sec and Geekbench image processing at 17489.0. Single-core performance is average, with a stress-ng single-core score of 1698.79 and a Geekbench single-core score of 1807.0.

The Intel processor supports advanced instruction sets, including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX_TILE and AMX_INT8) for matrix math acceleration. These instructions contribute to strong LLM inference speeds, such as 224.22 tokens/sec for 7B model prompt processing. Given the high memory-to-vCPU ratio and strong database operations score of 29375.76 on Passmark, this server is configured for memory-intensive workloads, database operations, static web serving, and CPU-based machine learning inference.
